name: Astral-Ossuary
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past massive canyon systems, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Something scrubbed this biosphere clean within a geological instant. The rocks remember it as a thin black line.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
